notes.title: Biggest update ever
notes.content:
Forktruck Challenge gameplay was re-created from scratch to address issues, pointed in the various feedback channels, mostly addressing physics stability, controls sensitivity, driving and VR 

With the new multiplayer challenge game mode two players can now compete, completing various challenges. More zones and more challenges are creating now.

Now fully supports Oculus Rift (Steam VR support will follow soon)

notes.title: Experimental VR update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9537695/0fccf4c4f708604d534976c5c97e10cee1e8d565.jpg[/img]

First of all, big thanks to Matt form Bonozo Apps for helping me with VR testing (and me failing).
VR support is experimental and it is activated/deactivated while pressing [V] button (if it is deactivated at the start). Supports Oculus and OpenVR. Please, feel free to post some screenshots and videos of your VR experience, or message me on Twitter/Twitch @MintArcade if you have any issues.

Beside experimental VR support, there is fixing of some issues from negative reviews, including, but not limited too:
- Network physics stability.
- Cargo "spawn" points.
- Faster loading time and more.
Actually, for whatever reason, most loading time is actually connecting to Steam, but I'm working on that, hopefully it will be implemented in the next build.

Happy forklifting.[img][/img]

notes.title: More fixes, approaching release.
notes.content:
After a lot of work with physics and network engine, "BIG CARGO" update now is live on Early Access. Enjoy more cargo types and more challenging experience. Now game looks more like real life warehouses.

- 20+ new standard, tall and long cargo types.
- Over network physics synchronization now more stable. Although, on low-end PC's and Mac game is still laggy - I'm working on that.
- Sound effect fixed for some damage types.

To do:
- Fix audio lag for local player fork operation and electric forklift.
- Sensitivity options for driving.
- Find and fix more bugs.
- Marketing.

"Hidden" VR settings. Press V in Option -> Controls to activate VR. If you have one connected and properly configured, you should experience this game in VR. Never tested, please let me know if you have an issue.

Also, please let me know if physics and network are better now. And if you have any issues, please contact me on twitter @MintArcade and your problem will be sorted much much faster, compare to anyone writing review ;)

notes.content:

Release date is still unclear, but it is approaching. Make sure to follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/MintArcade]Twitter @MintArcade[/url] for the latest news, updates and other projects.

notes.title: Many small bugs fixes
notes.content:
First of all, big thanks to Matt, who played the game on he's [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bonozoapps]Twitch Stream[/url] recently and to all players, who had a blast by making a mess in multiplayer game - that was fun!

In this "quiet" update, most of the bugs, pointed by the Stream viewers, was eliminated.

Fixes:
- Player model are now hidden and you can only see other players. This was done to reduce "flicker" and to prepare the way for VR implementation.
- Players now can lift (in theory) another player's forklift.
- Cargo break sound can be changed in SFX settings.
- Pallet kinematic fixed, no more floating pallets.
- Reset / Menu / Cancel now working on small screen.
- Forklift controls disable while typing in chat.
- Chat disappear speed is now slowed down.
- Chat now have sound.
- Breaks lights.
- Controls are polished for use with searing wheel.
- Electrical forklift have correct engine and fork operating sound. (More polishing needed)

And of course -  [url=https://twitter.com/MintArcade/status/736660220911439872]explosives![/url]

notes.title: "Like a whole new game" update.
notes.content:
Lost of new updates in version 0.2.0, First of all two new fork truck models are looking much better and now there is an operator - no more invisible man in a driver seat.

Secondly, multiplayer have now much stable physics interaction. All known network bugs have been eliminated, hopefully, when game servers will be split into the territories it will be even better.

Next, third forktruck will be in the game as soon as possible
Fork Truck Challenge: New selection menu

Some fixes and known issues

Fixes:

Camera rotation and sensitivity.
Audio loop for forks rise an lower in multiplayer.
Derby are not causing lag.
Driving stability and handling.
Automatic breaks on slops.
Score system now appears properly on the back of a forktruck in multiplayer mode.
Known issues:

Audio lag while operating forks in singleplayer mode.
Operator model are sometimes disappear from camera view.
Trains are not bringing enough cargo in "Desert" map.

Please, if you have found a bug or have a awesome feedback, please don't hesitate to send me a message on Steam or Twitter @mintarcade

Thank you

notes.title: New levels and more bugs fixes
notes.content:
Fork Truck Challenge had some really interesting updates in this 0.1.2 Early Access version. Thanks all for the valuable feedback helped to resolve some issues in the last few months. How, when the core game mechanics works as intended, release date will be known soon.

What's new:
- Singleplayer mode is back, so forget your friends for a moment ;)
- Cargo values has been set according to type of cargo.
- Two new levels to play.

Fixed:
Cargo sync over network.

To fix:
When train arriving or departure it can stop an stay as long as the multiplayer game is active if "master client" is gone. Fix in progress.
Pallets are not destroyed properly in rare cases. Fix in progress.

What next:
Two more levels and new fork truck models will be implemented in the game, more cargo and cargo types is almost ready for the next build.

notes.title: Lots of small and big changes.
notes.content:
Fork Truck Challenge early access version 0.1.0 is here. This is multiplayer only version just to test new network system. Singleplayer mode and levels will be re-enabled shortly. 

What's new:
- Cargo score is now working properly, giving the player more information on what was added into the total.
- Now it is possible to damage and destroy any cargo. 
- New smaller crates are not attached to the pallets to make it more difficult to move around.
- Trains and conveyor belts bringing and taking away cargo, so you never run out of missions to complete.
- New menu makes navigation much simpler to use with controller.
- Steam Leaderboard.
- Forktruck reset (<Esc> button)
- Camera have more wider range of movement.
- More precise forktruck controls on slow speed.
- Forktruck in now faster and more stable, especially on a ramp or while turning.

Fixes:
- Network optimized to allow more players
- Graphics issues fixes
- Known bugs removed.

What next:
Your feedback, comments and reviews that what will make that game better.
More cargo and levels are coming soon (before release).
I still debating whatever first person controller is needed, as player will be able to leave their forktruck and walk around, move crates and return back. That will most certainly eliminate need to mess up more with camera point of view and bring more realism. One downside is there in no good player model to put into the game. Please let me know if this is necessary or not.

Thank you.
